title: ghostcite: deterministic detection of ghost citations and retracted references
description: A deterministic, no-LLM command-line tool that catches ghost citations — references whose claimed author or year does not match the canonical record for the DOI at CrossRef (and optionally PubMed) — and flags retracted or expression-of-concern works. Ships as a pre-commit hook and a GitHub Action for continuous citation integrity checking in manuscript repositories.
